spans.s:
अखेटिकः [न खेटत्यस्मात्; खिट् भये
षिकन् Tv.]
1 A tree in general.
--2
(आखेटिक) A dog trained to the chase.

अखेदिन् a. Not wearisome, not
fatigued; ˚त्वं continuous flow of
speech regarded as one of the वाग्गुणs
of the Jainas.

आखेटः [आखिट्यंते त्रास्यंते प्राणिनोऽत्र,
आ-खिट्-घञ् Tv.] Hunting, chase.
--Comp.
--शीर्षकं {1} a smooth floor or
ground (कुट्टिमभेद). {2} a mine, cavern.

आखेटक a. Hunting, frightening
(as beasts of prey &c.).
--कः A
hunter;

आखेटिक a. [आखेटे कुशलः ठक्]
1
Skilful in chase.
--2 Terrible,
frightful.
--कः
1 A hunter.
--2 A hound.
